title: Reference Equations for the Six-Minute Walk Distance in Healthy Chinese Adults
author: He Zou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.i9sch6e
materials: Appropriate shoes for walking should be worn.

steps.title: Prepare the testing environment
steps.instruction: Set up a 30 m walking course in a long, flat, straight, enclosed corridor with a hard surface that is seldom traveled (or outdoors if weather is comfortable).

steps.title: Gather required equipment
steps.instruction: Ensure the following items are available at the testing site:

substeps.instruction: Two small cones for turnaround points

steps.title: Verify subject preparation
steps.instruction: Confirm the subject has adhered to the following pre-test requirements:

substeps.instruction: No vigorous exercise within 2 hours of the test
A light meal is acceptable for early morning or early afternoon tests

steps.title: Perform pre-test resting and screening
steps.instruction: Have the subject sit at rest in a chair near the starting position for at least 10 minutes before starting the test.

substeps.instruction: Verify clothing and shoes are appropriate

steps.title: Conduct the six-minute walk test
steps.instruction: Position the subject and the operator at the starting line and instruct the subject to walk up and down the corridor as fast as possible for six minutes.

substeps.instruction: Start the timer as soon as the subject begins walking
Provide standardized encouragement every 60 seconds (e.g., 'you are doing well; you have five minutes left', 'good job; there are four minutes left')

steps.title: Perform post-test measurements and recording
steps.instruction: Collect all necessary data immediately following the completion of the walk.

substeps.instruction: Ask the subject: 'What, if anything, kept you from walking farther?'
Measure SpO2 and pulse rate using the pulse oximeter, then remove the sensor
Record the number of laps from the counter or worksheet tick marks
Record the additional distance covered in the final partial lap using wall markers
Calculate the total distance walked, rounding to the nearest meter, and record on the worksheet

steps.title: Conclude the session
steps.instruction: Congratulate the subject on their effort and offer a drink of water.
